verses.text: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.

segments.text: There we sat down, yea, we wept,

verses.text: Upon the willows in the midst thereof We hanged up our harps.

segments.text: Upon the willows in the midst thereof

verses.text: For there they that led us captive required of us songs, And they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

segments.text: For there they that led us captive required of us songs,
Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

verses.text: How shall we sing Jehovah’s song In a foreign land?

segments.text: How shall we sing Jehovah’s song

verses.text: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget her skill.

segments.text: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem,

verses.text: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, If I remember thee not; If I prefer not Jerusalem Above my chief joy.

segments.text: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth,

verses.text: Remember, O Jehovah, against the children of Edom The day of Jerusalem; Who said, Rase it, rase it, Even to the foundation thereof.

segments.text: Remember, O Jehovah, against the children of Edom
Who said, Rase it, rase it,

verses.text: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed, Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee As thou hast served us.

segments.text: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed,
Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee

verses.text: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones Against the rock.

segments.text: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones
